Priya N. (Finance): Heads-up: we're comparing TaxLedger and ClearInvoice for the reconciliation tool. Need a short vendor brief + risk callouts by Thu AM. Can procurement take point?
Marco D. (Procurement): I'll own vendor Q&A. Key asks: unit pricing (lines vs docs), pilot terms, minimums, retention fees, and any migration credits.
Ellen S. (EngOps): integration checks: native Snowflake ingestion, webhook rate limits, delta-reprocess without double-charge. Please ask for sample schema and typical payload size.
Sam (Audit): compliance: SOC2, IP protection, data segregation in multi-tenant env. Also ask whether auditors can export raw parsed data for spot checks.
vendor-bot: "TaxLedger: demo recording link + SOC2 available. ClearInvoice: requests NDA for sample dataset."
Priya N. (Finance): timeline: Marco gather pricing/OPEX rows, Ellen does integration effort estimate, Sam flags legal/audit blockers. I'll assemble a one-page recommendation.
Marco D. (Procurement): noted. I'll push for a 60-day pilot credit and a migration credit to offset mapping costs. Will update with rate cards by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
